'''Lodrex''' was the [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]] and owner of the tavern at [[Trevalis]], a [[Mining/Legends|mining]] settlement on [[Kallistas]]. He was a former miner until he lost his left [[Limb/Legends|arm]] due to an accident with a [[Mining laser/Legends|mining laser]]. His poverty meant that the missing limb was never replaced by a [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] arm.
